assumptions: the substrate executed the check as written (ASM-SUBSTRATE-INTEGRITY)
attrs.evidence: INV-R9.3’s packet instructed a reviewer to run `INV_MATERIALS=../materials node scripts/check-integration.mjs` and expect PASS. GPT-5.6 ran exactly that and got exit 2: both content materials verified and the PROMOTION PREDECESSOR was UNREACHABLE, because both scripts resolved it only through mosaic/factory.json git_dir — a path on the build machine. THE ARTIFACT WAS ALREADY CARRYING THE ANSWER: invariant-canonical.bundle ships inside the ZIP and GPT cloned it without trouble. scripts/canonical-repo.mjs now resolves in order — INV_CANONICAL_GIT_DIR, INV_CANONICAL_BUNDLE, the shipped ./invariant-canonical.bundle, the configured factory git_dir — and reports every path it tried when it finds none. Verified from a fresh extraction under env -i with an empty HOME: exit 0, predecessor resolved from `the bundle this artifact ships`.

coverage.domain: the four sources scripts/canonical-repo.mjs declares, in order
coverage.enumerator: the resolver’s own search list, which reports every path it tried

evidence_qualifiers.population: the declared resolution sources for the canonical predecessor

attrs.gap: AND THE WAY THIS SURVIVED INV-R9.3’s OWN VERIFICATION IS THE PART THAT GENERALISES. That round DID run the advertised command end-to-end from the packaged handoff and DID observe exit 0 — without overriding HOME, so the build machine’s repository was reachable and the portability question was never asked. A PORTABILITY CLAIM VERIFIED IN THE ENVIRONMENT THAT MAKES PORTABILITY UNNECESSARY IS NOT VERIFIED. Same shape as INV-R8.2’s selftest passing on the developer’s machine because his git config supplied an identity the clean machine lacked. The control now runs under env -i with an empty HOME. What remains untested is a reviewer whose environment differs in some OTHER way nobody has thought to strip.
attrs.prior_art: GPT-5.6’s INV-R9.3 audit §3. Git bundles are designed for exactly this offline transfer; the artifact carried the right transport and nothing consumed it.
attrs.review_focus: The resolver tries four sources and prefers the shipped bundle over the local factory. Is that the right precedence for a run ON the factory machine, where the local repository is the live one and the bundle is a snapshot?
attrs.statement: The source-aware integration verification advertised by the review packet runs to PASS using only the extracted artifact, the Git bundle it ships, and the content-addressed materials attached beside it — with no dependency on any path belonging to the machine that built it.
